h: Sheikh Daurawa says he will not campaign for any candidate in 2027
p: Prominent Kano cleric Sheikh Aminu Daurawa has said he will not campaign for any presidential candidate in 2027. He made the remark as parties step up their campaigns across the north. His position is being noted by political watchers in the region.
more: The cleric's statement was reported in Hausa-language coverage.
Parties are competing for influential voices in the north.
